abilities.name: Cleaving Strike
abilities.description: Delivers a strike to three adjacent tiles with +(15 + 2 * AGL)% Bodypart Damage and +(35 + 2 * STR)% Bleed Chance. Grants +(0.75 * PRC)% Counter Chance for 5 turns for each enemy hit by the strike. The effect stacks up to 3 times.

abilities.name: Blade Maintenance
abilities.description: Grants sword strikes +7% Bleed Chance if the equipped sword's Durability is above 80%, +5% Weapon Damage if it's above 90%, and +3% Crit Chance if it's above 95%. Reduces swords' Durability loss by 50% when blocking with them and by 25% when delivering strikes.

abilities.name: Keeping Distance
abilities.description: Repositions to an adjacent tile. Next turn delivers a free strike to a random adjacent enemy with +(40 + 2 * STR)% Stagger Chance and +(5 + 0.5 * AGL + 0.5 * PRC)% Crit Chance.

abilities.name: Gloat
abilities.description: Grants sword strikes +1.5% Crit Chance, +3% Weapon Damage, and +3% Energy Drain for each negative effect affecting the target. Doubles the bonuses if the negative effect is Bleeding.
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in STR PER VIT

abilities.name: Fencer's Stance
abilities.description: Activates "Fencer Stance" for 10 turns: +5% Counter Chance +5% Block Chance +5% Dodge Chance +8% Bleed Chance Using the ability tree's skills grants an extra stack of the effect (up to IV). Basic sword strikes prolong the effect's duration by 1 turn (up to 10) but reduce its number of stacks (no more than once per turn). Only one Stance effect can be active at a time.
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Steady Tempo
abilities.description: Using the ability tree's skills grants +15% Energy Restoration for 5 turns and reduces the cooldown of the ability tree's random Attack skill by 1 turn. The effect stacks up to 4 times.

abilities.name: Honed Edge
abilities.description: Sword hits grant +6% Bleed Chance and +4% Armor Penetration for 5 turns. The effect stacks up to 5 times.
unlockConditions: Invest 14 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Onrush
abilities.description: Performs a charge towards the target and delivers a strike with +(10 + PRC + AGL)% Weapon Damage and +(5 + 0.5 * AGL + 0.5 * STR)% Armor Penetration. If the target takes damage, applies it with -(1.5 * AGL)% Bleed Resistance and +PRC% Damage Taken for 4 turns. The effect doesn't stack.
unlockConditions: Invest 14 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Mutilating Lunge
abilities.description: Performs a charge towards the target and delivers a strike to its most damaged body part with +(35 + 1.5 * STR)% Stagger Chance, +(15 + 2.5 * PRC)% Bodypart Damage, and +(30 + STR + AGL)% Bleed Chance. If the strike doesn't cause an Injury, reduces the skill's cooldown by 4 turns.

abilities.name: Ferocity
abilities.description: Causing Injuries with axe strikes reduces the ability tree's cooldowns by 2 turns and replenishes (-6 + WIL)% Max Energy.

abilities.name: Cut Through
abilities.description: Applies the target with (-2 * AGL)% Block Chance and (-2 * STR)% Max Block Power for 3 turns (the effect doesn't stack). Then delivers a strike with +(5 + 1.5 * STR)% Weapon Damage, +(5 + STR + AGL)% Armor Penetration, and +(20 + 3 * PRC)% Armor Damage. Each Bleeding and degree of Injury affecting the target grants the strike additional +(5 + 0.5 * PRC + 0.5 * AGL)% Weapon Damage.

abilities.name: No Mercy
abilities.description: Grants axe strikes +12% Weapon Damage if the target's Health is either above 90% or below 50%.

abilities.name: Reprisal
abilities.description: If the target isn't Injured, axe strikes against it grant +8% Bodypart Damage for 5 turns. The effect stacks up to 3 times. Grants axe strikes +4% Accuracy and -4% Fumble Chance for each degree of Injury affecting the target.
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Massacre
abilities.description: Activates "Massacre" for 10 turns: +5% Armor Penetration +12% Bodypart Damage +7% Bleed Chance +3% Crit Chance Using the ability tree's skills grants an extra stack of the effect (up to IV). Basic axe strikes prolong the effect's duration by 1 turn (up to 10) but reduce its number of stacks (no more than once per turn). Only one Stance effect can be active at a time.
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Execution
abilities.description: Delivers a strike to the target's head with +(1 + 0.05 * STR + 0.025 * AGL + 0.025 * PRC)% Weapon Damage for each missing percent of the target's Health. Grants the strike +5% Crit Chance for each degree of Injury affecting the target and +20% Crit Efficiency for each Bleeding. If the strike kills its target, replenishes (WIL * 2.5)% Max Energy.
unlockConditions: Invest 14 AP in STR AGI PER WIL

abilities.name: Tormenting Swings
abilities.description: Damaging axe strikes apply their target with -7% Bleed Resistance and -5% Max Health for 5 turns. The effect stacks up to 5 times.
unlockConditions: Invest 14 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Onslaught
abilities.description: Applies the target with -AGL% Control Resistance for 3 turns (the effect doesn't stack). Then delivers a strike with +(40 + 3 * STR)% Knockback Chance. If the strike knocks the target back, repositions to the emptied tile and delivers an additional strike with +(20 + STR + PRC)% Daze Chance. If the first strike doesn't knock the target back, reduces the skill's cooldown by 3 turns.

abilities.name: Dazing Strikes
abilities.description: Damaging mace strikes against Dazed, Stunned, or Staggered targets apply them with -5% Accuracy, +5% Fumble Chance and -5% Weapon Damage for 6 turns. The effect stacks up to 3 times.

abilities.name: Armor Break
abilities.description: Delivers a strike with +(20 + 2 * AGL + 2 * STR)% Stagger Chance, +(5 + 2 * STR)% Armor Penetration, and +100% Armor Damage. Grants the strike additional +PRC% Armor Damage for each turn of Daze affecting the target and +(5 * PRC)% Armor Damage for each turn of Stun. If the target takes damage, applies it with +(5 + 0.5 * PRC)% Damage Taken and (-((5 + 0.5 * AGL)))% Move Resistance for 3 turns (the effect doesn't stack). Reduces the ability tree's cooldowns by 2 turns.

abilities.name: Moment of Weakness
abilities.description: Grants mace strikes against Dazed, Stunned, or Staggered targets +25% Bodypart Damage and +5% Crit Chance. Grants mace strikes +5% Daze Chance and +10% Stagger Chance for each degree of Injury affecting the target.

abilities.name: Respite
abilities.description: Dazing, Stunning, or Staggering targets with mace strikes replenishes (-3 + WIL)% Max Energy.
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in AGI PER WIL

abilities.name: Hammer and Anvil
abilities.description: Activates "Hammer and Anvil" for 10 turns: -3% Fumble Chance +25% Armor Damage +10% Daze Chance +10% Stagger Chance Using the ability tree's skills grants an extra stack of the effect (up to IV). Basic mace strikes prolong the effect's duration by 1 turn (up to 10) but reduce its number of stacks (no more than once per turn). Only one Stance effect can be active at a time.
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Knock Out
abilities.description: Delivers a strike to the target's head with +25% Weapon Damage, +(40 + 2 * STR + 2 * AGL)% Stagger Chance, and +(5 + 0.5 * AGL)% Crit Chance. Grants the strike additional +PRC% Weapon Damage for each turn of Daze affecting the target and +(5 * PRC)% Weapon Damage for each turn of Stun. If the target takes damage, puts all its abilities on cooldown and prolongs its Daze by 4 turns and Stun by 1 turn.
unlockConditions: Invest 14 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Concussion
abilities.description: Using the ability tree's Attack skills applies the target with -5% Control Resistance, -5% Move Resistance, and -7% Crit Avoidance for 3 turns. The effect stacks up to 2 times.
unlockConditions: Invest 14 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Quick Hands
abilities.description: Successful, damaging dagger strikes reduce the ability tree's cooldowns by 1 turn. When no dagger is equipped, switching to a loadout with one grants +15% Counter Chance and +5% Crit Chance for 3 turns. The effect doesn't stack.

abilities.name: Double Lunge
abilities.description: Delivers two strikes with +(AGL + PRC)% Weapon Damage and +STR% Bodypart Damage. If the skill kills its target or both strikes deal damage, reduces the skill's cooldown by 3 turns.

abilities.name: Gaping Wound
abilities.description: Delivers a strike with +(AGL + STR)% Armor Penetration and +(30 + 2 * PRC)% Bleed Chance. If the target is Injured or Bleeding, applies it with "Gaping Wound" for 10 turns: +33% Abilities Energy Cost +33% Cooldowns Duration +10% Damage Taken (40 + PRC)% chance to start Bleeding after using an ability. Strikes, shots, moving to other tiles, and using abilities causes Bleedings to trigger twice per turn.

abilities.name: From the Shadows
abilities.description: Hitting targets with a dagger for the first time applies them with +33% Damage Taken for 3 turns. The effect doesn't stack. Grants dagger strikes against Unaware or Confused targets +25% Weapon Damage and +25% Armor Penetration. Thrown daggers deal 50% more damage.

abilities.name: Deadly Trick
abilities.description: With (100 + 2 * AGL)% chance swaps places with the target. If the swap is successful, grants +15% Counter Chance and +25% Bleed Chance for 2 turns. Then delivers a strike with +(AGL + PRC)% Weapon Damage, +(55 + AGL + STR)% Stagger Chance, +STR% Crit Chance, and +100% Energy Drain.
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Weakening Jabs
abilities.description: Damaging dagger strikes apply their targets with -5% Weapon Damage and +7.5% Cooldowns Duration for 6 turns. The effect stacks up to 4 times.

abilities.name: Painful Stabs
abilities.description: Activates "Painful Stabs" for 10 turns: +4% Crit Chance +10% Crit Efficiency +5% Weapon Damage +12% Bleed Chance Using the ability tree's skills grants an extra stack of the effect (up to IV). Basic dagger strikes prolong the effect's duration by 1 turn (up to 10) but reduce its number of stacks (no more than once per turn). Only one Stance effect can be active at a time.
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Counterattack Mastery
abilities.description: Dagger strikes grant +5% Counter Chance for 6 turns. The effect stacks up to 4 times. Grants dagger counters +33% Weapon Damage.

abilities.name: Danse Macabre
abilities.description: Critical dagger strikes grant +4% Dodge Chance for 8 turns and apply their target with +5% Damage Taken and -5% Bleed Resistance for 8 turns. The effect stacks up to 4 times.
unlockConditions: Invest 14 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Coup de Grace
abilities.description: Delivers a strike to the target's body or head with +(2 * STR)% Armor Penetration, +(2 * PRC)% Bodypart Damage for each Bleeding affecting the target, and +(1 + (0.025 * AGL + 0.025 * PRC))% Weapon Damage for each missing percent of its Health. If the strike kills its target, it doesn't take a turn and grants +25% Crit Chance for 4 turns.
unlockConditions: Invest 14 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Hewing Strike
abilities.description: Delivers a strike to one of the target's hands with +(30 + 1.5 * AGL + 1.5 * STR)% Bleed Chance and +(3 * PRC)% Bodypart Damage. If the target takes damage, applies it with (-((STR + PRC)))% Move Resistance and (-((AGL + PRC)))% Bleed Resistance for 4 turns (the effect doesn't stack). Doubles the skill's effects if the target is Staggered. Successful two-handed sword counters reduce the skill's cooldown by 1 turn.

abilities.name: Revanche
abilities.description: Two-handed sword counters replenish (-6 + WIL)% Max Energy and grant -10% Skills Energy Cost for 2 turns. The effect stacks up to 2 times.

abilities.name: Parry
abilities.description: Activates "Parry" for 3 turns: +(AGL + PRC)% Block Chance +STR% Max Block Power +(10 + PRC)% Counter Chance Fully replenishes Block Power. While affected by "Parry", each blocked strike reduces the skill's cooldown by 2 turns and grants +10% Block Power Recovery for 3 turns, and each counter grants +2% Crit Chance for 5 turns. The effect stacks up to 4 times.

abilities.name: Recklessness
abilities.description: Grants +3% Crit Chance, +5% Counter Chance, and -5% Damage Taken for each adjacent enemy if there's more than one. The effect stacks up to 3 times.
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in AGI PER VIT WIL

abilities.name: Feast of Steel
abilities.description: Activates "Feast of Steel" for 10 turns: +5% Counter Chance -4% Fumble Chance +5% Accuracy +3% Crit Chance Grants +100% Stagger Chance to every third strike. Using the ability tree's skills grants an extra stack of the effect (up to IV). Basic two-handed sword strikes prolong the effect's duration by 1 turn (up to 10) but reduce its number of stacks (no more than once per turn). Only one Stance effect can be active at a time.
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Arc Cleave
abilities.description: Delivers a strike to five adjacent tiles with +(10 + PRC)% Weapon Damage, +(50 + STR)% Stagger Chance, and +(20 + 2 * AGL)% Bleed Chance. Reduces the ability tree's cooldowns by 1 turn for each enemy hit by the strike and replenishes (-5 + WIL)% Max Energy for each enemy Staggered by the strike.
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Fight to the Death
abilities.description: Consecutive two-handed sword hits against the same target grant +7% Stagger Chance and +3% Counter Chance for 5 turns. Each received strike grants +3% Block Chance and +5% Block Power Recovery for 5 turns. Both effects stack up to 3 times.
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in STR PER VIT

abilities.name: Taste of Victory
abilities.description: Two-handed sword hits against Staggered targets grant +10% Bodypart Damage and +10% Bleed Chance for 5 turns. The effect stacks up to 3 times. Killing enemies with two-handed swords prolongs the duration of "Feast of Steel" and "Parry" by 1 turn.
unlockConditions: Invest 14 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Heroic Charge
abilities.description: Performs a charge towards the target and delivers a strike with +(70 + AGL + STR)% Stagger Chance. Each traveled tile grants the strike +PRC% Weapon Damage and +(0.25 * STR + 0.25 * AGL)% Crit Chance.
unlockConditions: Invest 14 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Courage
abilities.description: If the ability tree's skill kills its target, instantly refreshes its cooldown. If the target survives, grants +5% Weapon Damage for 4 turns for each adjacent enemy. The effect stacks up to 3 times.
unlockConditions: Invest 14 AP in STR AGI WIL

abilities.name: Hooking Chop
abilities.description: Delivers a strike with math_round(-30 + PRC)% Weapon Damage, +math_round(60 + STR + PRC)% Bleed Chance, and +math_round(5 + STR + AGL)% Armor Penetration. Grants the strike a math_round(80 + STR + AGL + Knockback_Chance)% chance to pull the target if it's 1 tile away. Deals damage to an additional body part besides the one hit by the strike.

abilities.name: Shieldbreaker
abilities.description: Two-handed axe hits apply their targets with -10% Block Chance, -10% Block Power Recovery, and -15% Max Block Power for 6 turns. If the target's Block Chance is 0%, two-handed axe strikes against it grant -4% Fumble Chance for 6 turns. Both effects stack up to 5 times.

abilities.name: Dismember
abilities.description: Delivers a strike with +math_round(20 + 3 * PRC)% Bodypart Damage and +math_round(0.5 * AGL + 0.5 * STR)% Crit Chance to one of the target's body parts with a Minor or Moderate Injury. If the target has no Injuries, delivers the strike to its most damaged limb. If the strike worsens an Injury or causes a new one, the target loses math_round(7.5 + 0.25 * STR)% Max Health (but no more than (15 + STR)), and the affected body part has math_round(100 + 2 * PRC)% chance to start Bleeding.

abilities.name: Rampage
abilities.description: Activates "Rampage" for 10 turns: -10% Skills Energy Cost +4% Crit Chance +15% Bleed Chance -3% Fumble Chance Every third strike deals additional damage equal to 15% of the target's Max Health (but no more than math_round(20 + STR * 0.5)). Using the ability tree's skills grants an extra stack of the effect (up to IV). Basic two-handed axe strikes prolong the effect's duration by 1 turn (up to 10) but reduce its number of stacks (no more than once per turn). Only one Stance effect can be active at a time.
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Fatal Strike
abilities.description: Critical two-handed axe strikes grant -15% Skills Energy Cost for 3 turns and apply their target with +10% Damage Taken for 3 turns. Both effects stack up to 2 times.

abilities.name: Finish 'Em!
abilities.description: Grants two-handed axe strikes +15% Bodypart Damage and +4% Accuracy if the target's Health is above 50%. Grants two-handed axe strikes +10% Weapon Damage and -4% Fumble Chance if the target's Health is below 50%.
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Reign in Blood
abilities.description: Delivers a strike with +math_round(40 + 2 * STR)% Knockback Chance and +math_round(2 * AGL + 2 * PRC)% Bodypart Damage for each Bleeding affecting the target and each missing 20% of its Health. With math_round(40 + PRC + STR)% chance causes the target's Injured body parts to start Bleeding. Then replenishes math_round(0.5 * WIL)% Max Energy for each Bleeding and degree of Injury affecting the target.
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Tool of Execution
abilities.description: Using "Rampage" grants +10% Bodypart Damage, +10% Crit Efficiency, and -5% to the ability tree's Cooldowns Duration for 8 turns for each enemy within 5 tiles. The effect stacks up to 5 times.
unlockConditions: Invest 14 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Make Space
abilities.description: Delivers a strike to a 3x2 tile area with -200% Knockback Chance as well as +math_round(1.5 * PRC)% Weapon Damage and +math_round(STR + AGL)% Armor Penetration for each degree of Injury affecting the targets within the skill's area of effect. This strike can't knock back its targets. Hitting a target applies it with -5% Bleed Resistance for 6 turns for each enemy within the skill's area of effect. The effect stacks up to 6 times. If the strike kills at least one target, delivers it again to the same area (but no more than once).
unlockConditions: Invest 14 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Maim and Kill
abilities.description: Causing Injuries and Bleeding with two-handed axe strikes grants +5% Weapon Damage and +4% Crit Chance for 5 turns. The effect stacks up to 3 times. Two-handed axe hits against targets affected by two or more Injuries replenish math_round(-5 + WIL)% Max Energy.
unlockConditions: Invest 14 AP in STR AGI PER WIL

abilities.name: Keep Them Coming
abilities.description: Killing enemies with the ability tree's skills or critical two-handed mace strikes activates "Mighty Swing" for 1 turn and grants +15% Energy Restoration for 4 turns. The effect stacks up to 2 times.

abilities.name: Mighty Swing
abilities.description: Activates "Mighty Swing" for 1 turn: +40% Weapon Damage +40% Stagger Chance +20% Stun Chance +40% Bodypart Damage +40% Armor Damage -200% Counter Chance

abilities.name: Unstoppable Force
abilities.description: Delivers a strike to three adjacent tiles with +math_round(50 + 2 * STR)% Knockback Chance and +math_round(30 + 3 * PRC)% Armor Damage. Grants -10% Skills Energy Cost for 3 turns for each target that is knocked back by the strike. The effect stacks up to 3 times. If affected by "Mighty Swing", and the strike knocked the target back, puts its abilities on a 2 turn cooldown.

abilities.name: Unbalance
abilities.description: Staggering or knocking targets back with two-handed mace strikes applies them with -5% Control Resistance, +5% Fumble Chance, and -10% Dodge Chance for 4 turns. The effect stacks up to 3 times.

abilities.name: Striker Stance
abilities.description: Activates "Striker Stance" for 10 turns: +3% Crit Chance +10% Knockback Chance +10% Armor Penetration +15% Stagger Chance Grants +100% Daze Chance to every third strike. Using the ability tree's skills grants an extra stack of the effect (up to IV). Basic two-handed mace strikes prolong the effect's duration by 1 turn (up to 10) but reduce its number of stacks (no more than once per turn). Only one Stance effect can be active at a time. If affected by "Mighty Swing", using the skill delivers a strike to a random adjacent enemy.
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Bonebreaker
abilities.description: Grants two-handed mace strikes +35% Armor Damage if the target's Armor Durability is above 50%. Grants two-handed mace strikes +20% Bodypart Damage if the target has no Armor or its Armor Durability is below 50%.

abilities.name: Forceful Slam
abilities.description: Delivers a strike with -50% Weapon Damage and +75% Immobilization Chance and also prolongs the target's Daze, Stun, and Stagger by 1 turn. This strike can't knock back its targets. If the next turn the target is adjacent, delivers a free strike to it with +math_round(0.5 * AGL + 0.5 * STR)% Crit Chance. If the target is Immobilized, Stunned, Dazed, or Staggered, grants this strike +math_round(25 + PRC)% Weapon Damage. If the target is Stunned, also doubles the bonus to Crit Chance. If affected by "Mighty Swing", prolongs its duration by 1 turn, and the first strike applies the target with -10% Crushing Resistance for 3 turns (the effect doesn't stack).
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Revel in Battle
abilities.description: While affected by "Striker Stance", killing enemies with two-handed maces replenishes math_round(10 + WIL)% Max Energy. If affected by both "Striker Stance" and "Mighty Swing" at the same time, killing enemies with two-handed maces reduces the ability tree's cooldowns by 4 turns and grants +20% Stun Chance for 3 turns. The effect stacks up to 2 times.
unlockConditions: Invest 14 AP in STR AGI PER WIL

abilities.name: Skull Crusher
abilities.description: Performs a charge towards the target and delivers a strike to its head with +math_round(10 + 2 * STR + 2 * PRC)% Stun Chance and +math_round(5 + PRC + AGL)% Bodypart Damage. If affected by "Mighty Swing", grants the skill +1 Range, +50% Stagger Chance, and +50% Immobilization Chance.
unlockConditions: Invest 14 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Severe Concussion
abilities.description: Dazing, Stunning, or Staggering targets with two-handed mace strikes applies them with -15% Move Resistance, -10% Accuracy, and +10% Fumble Chance for 4 turns. The effect stacks up to 2 times.
unlockConditions: Invest 14 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Precise Hits
abilities.description: Grants spear strikes against targets affected by Immobilization or "Net" +10% Armor Penetration and +15% Bodypart Damage.

abilities.name: Nail Down
abilities.description: Delivers a strike to one of the target's legs with +math_round(0.5 * AGL)% Crit Chance. If the target is adjacent, grants the strike +math_round(5 + AGL + PRC)% Weapon Damage and +math_round(30 + STR + AGL)% Knockback Chance. If the target is 1 tile away, grants the strike +math_round(5 + PRC + AGL)% Bodypart Damage and +math_round(30 + 1.5 * STR + 1.5 * PRC)% Immobilization Chance.

abilities.name: Impaling Lunge
abilities.description: Delivers a strike to a 2x1 tile area with +math_round(2 * PRC)% Bodypart Damage, +math_round(2 * AGL)% Armor Penetration, and +math_round(30 + 2 * STR)% Bleed Chance. If the target is affected by Immobilization or "Net" grants the strike -35% Weapon Damage, -100% Immobilization Chance, halves all other bonuses, and instantly refreshes the skill's cooldown.

abilities.name: No Retreat
abilities.description: Remaining on the same tile grants -3% Cooldowns Duration, +3% Weapon Damage, and +3% Counter Chance for 4 turns. The effect stacks up to 3 times. Moving to other tiles removes the effect (except when moving with Maneuvers).

abilities.name: Pikeman Stance
abilities.description: Activates "Pikeman Stance" for 10 turns: +5% Accuracy +5% Bleed Chance +15% Knockback Chance +8% Immobilization Chance Using the ability tree's skills grants an extra stack of the effect (up to IV). Remaining on the same tile prolongs the effect's duration by 1 turn (up to 10), and basic spear strikes reduce its number of stacks (no more than once per turn). Only one Stance effect can be active at a time.
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in STR PER VIT

abilities.name: Wounding Spearhead
abilities.description: Grants critical spear strikes +20% Bodypart Damage. Critical spear strikes deal additional damage equal to 10% of the target's Max Health (but no more than math_round(STR + AGL)).

abilities.name: Determination
abilities.description: Activates "Determination" for 2 turns: Delivers a free strike with +math_round(AGL + PRC)% Weapon Damage and +math_round(55 + 2 * STR)% Bleed Chance to every enemy that moves to adjacent tiles. If this strike does damage, replenishes math_round(-5 + WIL)% Max Energy and applies the target with -20% Move Resistance for 3 turns.
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in STR AGI PER WIL

abilities.name: One at a Time!
abilities.description: Grants +5% Weapon Damage, +5% Immobilization Chance, and +3% Crit Chance if there is only one adjacent enemy. Doubles the bonuses if the adjacent tiles are empty.

abilities.name: Regroup
abilities.description: Repositions to an adjacent tile, replenishes math_round(2 * Vitality)% Max Block Power, and reduces the cooldowns of the ability tree's other skills by 1 turn for each visible enemy within 3 tiles. Activates "Regroup" for 10 turns: +5% Block Chance +5% Max Block Power +15% Block Power Recovery +5% Counter Chance Grants an extra stack of the effect (up to IV) for each reduced cooldown.
unlockConditions: Invest 14 AP in STR AGI VIT

abilities.name: Stay Back!
abilities.description: When enemies move to adjacent tiles, applies them with -10% Physical Resistance and -10% Crit Avoidance for 4 turns. The effect stacks up to 2 times. Grants spear strikes against adjacent targets +30% Knockback Chance.

abilities.name: Taking Aim
abilities.description: Activates "Taking Aim" for 1 turn: +(59 + 1 * ranged_skill_learned)% Accuracy +PRC% Weapon Damage +10% Range Each enemy within 4 tiles additionally grants to the effect: +(3 * STR)% Knockback Chance +(3 * AGL)% Immobilization Chance +(3 * PRC)% Stagger Chance The bonus to Accuracy depends on the number of learned Ranged Weapons abilities. The effect is removed if not equipped with a ranged weapon.

abilities.name: Constant Practice
abilities.description: Reduces the distance penalties to Accuracy and Fumble Chance (from -2% and +2% per tile to -1% and +1% respectively). Reduces the penalties to Accuracy when shooting over small (from -15% to -10%) and medium-sized obstacles (from -30% to -20%). Reduces the Accuracy penalty to bows when shooting at adjacent targets (from -50% to -35%) and targets that are 1 tile away (from -25% to -15%). Grants sling shots +25% Accuracy. Each tile of distance to the target reduces the bonus by 5%.

abilities.name: Dexterity
abilities.description: Killing enemies with melee strikes activates "Taking Aim" for 1 turn the next time the character switches to the loadout with an equipped ranged weapon (if the weapon is a crossbow, also instantly reloads it). If equipped with a ranged weapon, switching to the loadout with a melee weapon doesn't take a turn. Halves the chance of ammo to break upon hitting its target (this affects fumbled and blocked shots as well).

abilities.name: Distracting Shot
abilities.description: Performs a charge towards the targeted tile. Before charging, takes a shot at the closest enemy within Attack Range with (-60 + AGL)% Weapon Damage and +(40 + STR)% Immobilization Chance. Hitting the target grants +Vitality% Energy Restoration and +PRC% Dodge Chance for 5 turns and reduces cooldowns of all skills by 1 turn. The effect stacks up to 2 times. If equipped with a sling, grants the skill +1 Range, and hitting the target reduces its cooldown by 2 turns.

abilities.name: Spot Weakness
abilities.description: Grants +5% Armor Penetration and +5% Bodypart Damage to "Taking Aim". Using "Taking Aim" applies all targets within Vision with -5% Physical Resistance for 4 turns. If equipped with a sling, also applies the targets with -5% Control Resistance and -5% Move Resistance for 4 turns. Both effects stack up to 2 times.

abilities.name: Startling Volley
abilities.description: Marks a tile (2 different tiles or the same tile twice if equipped with a bow or sling).  Then takes a shot at them with (-40 + AGL)% Weapon Damage and +(20 + STR + PRC)% Daze Chance. Applies damaged targets with (-STR)% Block Chance and +(0.5 * PRC + 0.5 * AGL)% Fumble Chance for 5 turns. If the same target wasn't marked twice, doubles the applied penalties' duration. If equipped with a crossbow, instantly reloads it and doubles the applied penalties.
unlockConditions: Invest 8 AP in STR AGI PER

abilities.name: Suppression
